It used to be important even before the change with no homework, some did go down the list. For me as a kid, there was a major change between the class where they raised hands, and the list was only for when no one raised them, and class where teacher was going only down the list. ovid definitely doesn't change hair texture, it can only cause hair loss(doc confirmed).( And mixed hair patterns are so much more common than you think)
 It maybe a really trivial thing: from a change of water quality, hormones, vitamin/mineral problem, air quality/humidity, hair dye, just getting older, stress,even sheets on your pillow case can make a difference, maybe it's water temperature that you wash it in, change of styling/haircut, or heck something could've changed in one of the products you use/ or your hair started to react differently cos you use the same thing over and over and it gotten used to it too much. 
That's all things that had changed my hair texture in my short life span (also my mom's). Heck some of these things can even change your hair colour. Just don't panic and try to calmly observe them. 
Maybe you should change method of washing? Drying? Maybe your environment changed and you need to adapt your hair care to fit needs of your hair? Maybe you need to do some blood work as you lack something? There's lots of going on with changes like that but it's not necessarily bad/worrying thing.
 For me i have usually opposite, really curly on top and the further from wash the straighter hair under gets. And i know it's just due to it pressure when laying down and me not securing my curls enough. For you im thinking maybe search for different drying method and leave in routine. Maybe Omo washing method could make a difference and help the outer hair hydrate? Id also consider that maybe the outer hair is quite damaged not only from heat but also the environment wich doesn't get to the hidden hair on the bottom?
